title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — No Remorse
A threat against an officer leads to a major shakedown; an alleged gang leader becomes a magnet for trouble; a high-speed chase ends with the discovery of a 21-year-old murder victim and now the jail must deal with her cold-blooded killer.

title: Crime Inc.
description:

Car theft rings that operate as global enterprises, exporting stolen luxury cars to Africa, Asia and Eastern Europe.

title: Crime Inc.
description:

How the lucrative underworld of health care fraud can put peoples money, health and lives at risk; businessmen who sell phony insurance policies.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E4 — The Boy Toy Killer
When a wealthy Texas retiree is found dead in a ravine in Mexico, all eyes turn to his young boyfriend, a porn actor; while investigators uncover the truth behind their relationship, border crossing records provide the key to solving the case.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E5 — My Name Is Clark Rockefeller
A serial imposter pretends to be an aristocrat and Rockefeller fortune heir; when bones are dug up behind a house in an affluent California community, police want to know who Clark Rockefeller really is.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E7 — The Falcon and the Con Man
A man attempts suicide and confesses to an extraordinary fraud that he perpetrated for the past two decades at a leading commodity futures brokerage.

description:

Middle-aged real estate investor finds young love and steals client money to impress his new bride.
